cards.fabled: Every other turn the enemy instead hits themselves for 65% of their damage. This card cannot be shielded. All other dragons gain a shield on reflect.

cards.normal: On entry, grant the last ally in your deck 150% of your damage, but dies in 2 turns
cards.fabled: On entry, grant the last ally in your deck damage equal to 150% of this card's damage, but they die in 4 turns.

cards.normal: While on the field, stops any new enemy abilities from happening, however, it doesnt remove dodge chance from abilities
cards.fabled: While on the field, stop new enemy abilities and reduce incoming damage by 15%.

cards.normal: If a card died before this one is played, then do 300% damage on this card's next hit, If no card has died, then instead do no damage on your attack turns and boost allies health and damage by 10% each turn
cards.fabled: If a card died before this one is played, deal 450% damage on this card's next hit. Otherwise, skip attacks and boost allies' health and damage by 15% each turn.

cards.normal: Deals bonus damage based on the target's position: +25% to the front enemy, +20% to the second, +15% to the third, and +10% to the fourth
cards.fabled: Deals bonus damage based on the target's position: +100% to the front enemy, +80% to the second, +65% to the third, and +50% to the fourth.

cards.normal: On entry, negate all damage from the first attack against this card and reflect 35% of that damage back to the attacker. If the attack kills the attacker, heal this card for 50% of their max health
cards.fabled: On entry, negate the first attack against this card and reflect 60% of that damage back to the attacker. If the reflection kills the attacker, heal for 75% of max health.

cards.normal: On entry, deal 15% of this card's damage to all enemies. For every card defeated, increase attack by 30%
cards.fabled: On entry, deal 25% of this card's damage to all enemies. For every card defeated from that damage, permanently gain 40% attack and 20% max health.

cards.normal: Start with a 30% chance to dodge, every time this card is hit, increase dodge chance by 10% to a max of 60%
cards.fabled: Start with a 35% chance to dodge. Every time this card is hit, increase dodge chance by 10% to a max of 75%. On dodge, gain 15% more damage.

cards.normal: Every other turn, reduce incoming damage by 70%. Every attack pierces for 35% damage to a random enemy. If the pierce defeats an enemy, attack a second time.
cards.fabled: Every other incoming attack deals 80% less damage. Every attack pierces a random enemy for 50% damage. If the pierce defeats an enemy, heal 20% max health and attack a second time.

cards.normal: Once per battle, when the Dread Lord dies, revive with full health and explode dealing your max health as damage
cards.fabled: Once per battle, when the Dread Lord dies, revive with full health and explode dealing your max health as damage to the current enemy and 30% of your max health to all other enemies

cards.normal: If an attack deals less than 25% max health, it is negated. If it exceeds that amount, the damage is reduced by that % of max health and increases by 5% to a max of 50%
cards.fabled: Negate attacks below 35% max health. Stronger attacks are reduced by 10% max health and decreases future damage taken by 4% max health, up to 40%.

cards.normal: Steal 30% of the enemies health and damage after defeating them
cards.fabled: After defeating an enemy, steal 45% of their max health and damage, healing by the max health stolen.

cards.normal: On this card's turn, increase stats by 15%
cards.fabled: At the start of every turn, gain 25% health and damage. Every third turn, all living enemies permanently lose 10% damage.

cards.normal: On entry, if the Enemy card has a lower rarity than this card, increase this card’s damage by 30%, then gain an extra attack. If the Enemy card has a higher rarity than this card, increase this card’s health by 50%, then gain a shield that blocks one attack
cards.fabled: On entry against a lower-rarity enemy, gain 50% damage, a shield, and an extra attack. Against a higher-rarity enemy, gain 75% health, a shield, and an extra attack. Against equal rarity, gain both stat boosts, a shield, and an extra attack.

cards.normal: When this card is attacked, it has a 40% chance to Freeze the attacker for 1 turn
The first time the enemy would take their turn, this card takes a turn instead
If the allied card before this one dies, copy that card's ability for the rest of the battle
On entry, Freeze the opposing card for 1 turn. Whenever this card eliminates a Frozen enemy, permanently increase its stats by 20%
Take 8% less damage for each other living ally. Once per battle, a hit that would drop this card below 40% health is negated and heals 25% of max health instead
On attack, reduce the target's max health by the damage dealt

At the start of battle, Freeze the two lowest-rarity enemy cards for 1 turn if their rarity is lower than this card’s rarity. Enemy cards with a lower rarity than this card deal 20% less damage to this card
cards.fabled: At the start of battle, Freeze the three lowest-rarity enemy cards for 1 turn if their rarity is lower than this card's rarity. Enemy cards with a lower rarity than this card deal 35% less damage to this card.

cards.normal: Attacks always target the lowest-health enemy. If the target is Frozen, this card deals 40% increased damage
cards.fabled: Attacks always target the lowest-health enemy. If the target is Frozen, this card deals 100% increased damage and heals for 20% of damage dealt.

cards.normal: The first time per battle the allied card directly before this card drops below 40% health, Freeze the opposing card for 1 turn and fully heal that allied card
cards.fabled: The first time per battle each allied card directly before this card drops below 50% health, Freeze the opposing card for 1 turn, fully heal that ally, and give them a shield.

cards.normal: On entry, increase this card’s stats by 30% if any enemy card is Frozen. Once per battle if this card would be defeated by an attack, it instead heals for the damage it would have taken
cards.fabled: On entry, increase this card's stats by 50% if any enemy card is Frozen. Once per battle, if this card would be defeated by an attack, it instead heals for the damage it would have taken and Freezes the attacker for 2 turns.

cards.normal: On entry, increase all allies' max health by 15% and heal them for 20% of their max health. Every other turn, gain a shield that blocks one attack and heal all allies for 8% of their max health
cards.fabled: On entry, increase all allies' max health by 40% and heal them for 30% of their max health. Every other turn, gain a shield that blocks one attack and heal all allies for 12% of their max health.

cards.normal: When this card defeats an enemy, that enemy is raised as a corrupted thrall for 1 turn at 40% of their original stats, attacking their former team before crumbling. This card heals 10% of its max health for each thrall raised
cards.fabled: When this card defeats an enemy, raise that enemy as a corrupted thrall for 2 turns at 55% of their original stats. This card heals 15% of max health and gains 10% damage for each thrall raised.

cards.normal: Whenever this card would be healed, double the amount and convert it into bonus damage instead. At the end of each turn, this card loses 8% of its max health and deals that amount as bonus damage on its next attack
cards.fabled: Whenever this card would be healed, triple the amount and convert it into bonus damage instead. At the end of each turn, lose 6% max health and add 150% of that amount as bonus damage on the next attack.

cards.normal: On each attack, reduce the target's max health by 50% of this card's damage and increase this card's damage by 25%
cards.fabled: On each attack, reduce the target's max health by 75% of this card's damage and increase this card's damage by 35%. If the target is defeated, carry half of the max-health reduction to the next enemy.

cards.normal: When this card would be defeated, instead survive with 1 health and curse the attacking enemy. If the cursed enemy is defeated before attacking again, heal this card for 20% of its max health and grant it a shield
cards.fabled: When this card would be defeated, instead survive with 1 health and curse the attacking enemy. If the cursed enemy is defeated before attacking again, heal this card for 35% max health, gain a shield, and permanently gain 20% damage.

cards.normal: Each attack applies 2 Void Fracture. When this card causes an enemy to Shatter, immediately attack again for 80% damage. The extra attack cannot trigger another extra attack
cards.fabled: Each attack applies 3 Void Fracture. When this card causes an enemy to Shatter, immediately attack again for 110% damage. The extra attack cannot trigger another extra attack

cards.normal: On entry, reverse the enemy team's order and apply 1 Void Fracture to every enemy. Every second attack sends the target to the back and transfers its Fracture stacks to the enemy brought forward

At the start of this card's turn, apply 1 Void Fracture to every enemy. Whenever an enemy Shatters, heal all allies for 10% of their max health and permanently increase all Void World allies' damage by 10%, up to 50%
cards.fabled: At the start of this card's turn, apply 2 Void Fracture to every enemy. Whenever an enemy Shatters, heal all allies for 15% of their max health and permanently increase all Void World allies' damage by 10%, up to 60%

cards.normal: Deal 25% more damage for each Void Fracture on the target. When an attack defeats an enemy, transfer its Fracture stacks and all excess damage to the next enemy at 150% strength. This can continue through multiple enemies
cards.fabled: Deal 35% more damage for each Void Fracture on the target. When an attack defeats an enemy, transfer its Fracture stacks and all excess damage to the next enemy at 175% strength. This can continue through multiple enemies

cards.normal: On entry, apply 2 Void Fracture to every enemy. Attacks apply 1 additional stack. While this card is active, Shattering no longer removes Fracture stacks. When an enemy Shatters, cancel its next ability activation and strike it for 100% damage. The same enemy can only Shatter once every 2 turns
cards.fabled: On entry, apply 3 Void Fracture to every enemy. Attacks apply 2 additional stacks. While this card is active, Shattering no longer removes Fracture stacks. When an enemy Shatters, cancel its next ability activation and strike it for 140% damage. The same enemy can only Shatter once every 2 turns

cards.normal: On entry, steal the ability of the strongest enemy card and use it as its own for the rest of the battle
cards.fabled: On entry, steal the ability of the strongest enemy card and use it as its own for the rest of the battle, and gain 20% health and damage
